descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Eyeline is five arcade games built on one idea: your left and right eyes don't see the same thing. The arrow on an orb, a drone's bolt or half of a Pong court may be shown to only one eye. Choose which eye leads, or play with both equal, and most games adapt to you as you play.

ORB SLICER
A blade in each hand. Orbs fly in on the beat; cut each with the blade of its colour, the way its arrow points. Five tracks, from Warm-up to Storm, and four songs.

DRONE DEFLECT
A drone circles you and fires. Block its bolts, send them back and bring it down. Five drones, each tougher than the last.

GHOSTBALL
Brick-breaking Pong across a glowing seam, each half of the court shown to one eye.

DUET PONG
A paddle in each hand and a rally between them. Keep the ball alive and build the music with every return.

TARGET PRACTICE
A shooting gallery, one eye at a time. Hit fast and close for the top score.

- Neon stages that move to the music
- Up to nine players per headset, each with their own scores
- Leaderboards after every round
- Play standing or seated
- Pause anytime with the menu button

HEALTH & SAFETY: This game uses flashing lights, bright colours and fast motion. If you or anyone in your family has had a seizure, a blackout or epilepsy, talk to a doctor before playing. Take regular breaks. Stop and rest if you feel dizzy or sick, get a headache or eye strain, or see double.

Eyeline is a game for entertainment, not a medical device; it does not diagnose or treat any condition.
